title: Insurance Coverage & Claims Registration Card: Member Identifiers, Subscriber Relationships and Termination Dating
content:
**Insurance Coverage & Claims** — registration reference for the details printed on a patient's card and for the way each payer class dates the end of a coverage.

## Member identifier and subscriber relationship

| Payer class | Member identifier format on the card | Patient-to-subscriber relationships the payer class allows | Child dependent covered through age (whole years) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | Medicare Beneficiary Identifier (MBI), 11 characters | Self | 0 (dependents not applicable) |
| Medicare Advantage Plan | Plan member ID as printed on the plan card | Self | 0 (dependents not applicable) |
| Medicare Supplement Plan | Supplement plan member ID as printed on the card | Self | 0 (dependents not applicable) |
| Medicaid Managed Care Plan | Plan member ID or state Medicaid ID as printed on the card | Self | 0 (dependents not applicable) |
| TRICARE Prime and Select | DoD Benefits Number (DBN), 11 digits | Self, spouse, child | 21 |
| Commercial In-Network Plan | Member ID as printed on the card, including any alpha prefix | Self, spouse, child, other dependent | 26 |
| Commercial Out-of-Network Plan | Member ID as printed on the card, including any alpha prefix | Self, spouse, child, other dependent | 26 |

## Termination date

| Payer class | How the termination date is set from the qualifying event |
|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | End of month |
| Medicare Advantage Plan | End of month |
| Medicare Supplement Plan | End of month |
| Medicaid Managed Care Plan | End of month |
| TRICARE Prime and Select | Date of event |
| Commercial In-Network Plan | End of month |
| Commercial Out-of-Network Plan | End of month |

## Card questions

**What is the member identifier format used for?** It is the format printed on the payer class's card, and it is used to check the member details before verification.

**Which payer classes cover a spouse?** TRICARE Prime and Select, Commercial In-Network Plan and Commercial Out-of-Network Plan. The four other payer classes allow only the patient as the subscriber.

**Through what age is a child covered?** Through age 21 under TRICARE Prime and Select and through age 26 under either commercial payer class; dependents do not apply to the other payer classes.

**Which payer class dates a termination on the event itself?** Only TRICARE Prime and Select; every other payer class uses the end of the month.
